verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own pages describe an employer-side service: securing H-1B and other work visas for employers, handling transfers for incoming hires, guiding employers through the annual cap and lottery, and preparing and maintaining LCAs and Public Access Files to Department of Labor requirements, plus PERM and compliance audits. All of this is first-party marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the firm files H-1B cap registrations itself (it only says it 'guides' employers through the lottery), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the employer service.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: We help employers secure H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, and other work visas, providing clear strategy, careful preparation, and steady communication.
We review their status and handle the transfer so they can start with you smoothly.
We guide employers through the annual cap, lottery selection process, and critical filing timelines so hiring plans stay on track.
we help you prepare and maintain Labor Condition Applications and Public Access Files that meet Department of Labor requirements.
